WITH conservation_by_status AS (
  SELECT 
    sites.insurstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) as site_count
  FROM scanconservation sc
  JOIN sites ON sc.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY sites.insurstat
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(site_count) as total_sites FROM conservation_by_status
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(cbs.insurstat, 'Missing')::text as status,
  cbs.site_count as count,
  cbs.site_count::float / t.total_sites as share
FROM conservation_by_status cbs
CROSS JOIN totals t;
